items.title: Secrecy Announce Debut EP Winter In A&E: Hear “Knife In My Dreams”
items.summary: Secrecy: Good name for a punk band! It calls to mind the Germs' "What We Do Is Secret," as well as the general sense of a hidden underground world that regards outsiders with suspicion. London's appropriately mysterious Secrecy have a big, propulsive sound — coarse hardcore vocals, reverb-drenched guitar jangle, booming drums. They bring a sense of frenetic darkness that recalls the moment that goth first emerged out of punk. There's at least a bit of Stone Roses glimmer in there, too.
